items.description:
SPAR Erica Square is a supermarket trading from Shop 1 within the Erica Square shopping centre in Belhar, part of the SPAR group of independently run stores that share central buying and distribution support while keeping local ownership and management. The store stocks everyday groceries, fresh produce and household essentials for shoppers doing a quick top-up or a full weekly shop.

Trading from Erica Drive, the branch forms part of the retail offering at Erica Square and serves the surrounding Belhar community and passing local shoppers. It keeps long, consistent trading hours seven days a week, including public holidays, making it a convenient stop for residents needing groceries outside normal office hours.

Sportsmans Warehouse Tokai-on-Main is a branch of the sporting goods retail chain that has traded in South Africa since 1986, now describing itself as the country's largest sports store. The branch carries sportswear, footwear, outdoor equipment and gear across a wide range of sporting codes, stocking well-known brands alongside its own in-house ranges for everyday training, competitive sport and outdoor pursuits.

The store trades from Shop 3 in the Tokai-on-Main Centre on Main Road, Tokai, and suits sports and outdoor enthusiasts shopping for equipment, apparel, footwear and accessories, whether outfitting a weekend hike, a gym session, a run or a club team's kit.

items.description:
The Building Centre is a building and renovation exhibition in Ysterplaat showcasing building products and design ideas for residential and commercial projects. Dating back to 1953, it offers free entry to its permanent exhibitions and hosts CPD-accredited talks for architects, alongside an events area and a boardroom used for industry presentations and training sessions.

The exhibition serves homeowners planning a renovation, architects and interior designers sourcing products and ideas, and property developers and other building professionals researching materials and suppliers. It operates from 7 Platinum Drive in Northgate Estate, Ysterplaat, next to Builders Warehouse, and suits anyone wanting to see building products and finishes in person before specifying or buying them.

Timbuktu Cafe is an Ethiopian and African restaurant in Observatory serving traditional Ethiopian dishes, including vegetarian plates and meat options such as lamb and chicken, with food traditionally served on injera flatbread. Vegan diners are also catered for, alongside a broader menu that draws on African culinary traditions beyond Ethiopia.

The restaurant serves breakfast, lunch and dinner, with outdoor seating and reservations available for diners who want to book ahead. It trades from 16 Lower Main Road, on the corner of Lower Main Road and Norfolk Street in Observatory, and suits anyone looking for Ethiopian or African cuisine, including vegetarian and vegan diners seeking a sit-down meal in a relaxed setting.

Tokers Trophies in Kensington is a trophy and engraving business tracing back to a company first registered in 1963, which began as a small jewellery, watch and ammunition shop. Ownership changed in 1978 and the business was built up over the following decades into the recognised trophy and awards supplier operating today.

The company changed its trading name to Tokers Trophies in 2014, and over its history it helped establish the laser cutting and engraving side of the recognition industry in South Africa. It remains a family-run business, supplying trophies and awards for sporting, corporate and academic achievements.

With more than 40 years in the industry, the business says it is ready to make any event memorable. It operates from Unit C4 in Maitland Park on Voortrekker Road in Kensington, and suits anyone needing awards or engraved recognition items for a function or ceremony.

items.description:
Twin Peak Spur is a family-style steakhouse inside the Pick n Pay Hypermarket in Ottery, part of the national Spur grill and steakhouse chain. The branch serves the familiar Spur menu of steaks, ribs, burgers and wings, alongside breakfast, lunch and dinner options for diners wanting a casual sit-down meal.

The restaurant is fully halal certified and does not serve alcohol, making it a reliable choice for halal diners as well as other families and diners in the area. It trades from the Pick n Pay Hypermarket in Ottery and suits families and diners looking for casual steakhouse and grill meals in a relaxed, kid-friendly setting.

Urban Optik Eyecare is an optometry and eyewear practice offering eye tests, all-inclusive spectacle packages and a range of eyewear brands and frames. The practice describes its approach as a fresh, modern take on eye-care and eyewear, aiming to combine clinical eye examinations with a personal, service-focused shopping experience for glasses and contact lenses.

The practice is part of a small group of Urban Optik stores and trades from Shop 63 in the Gardens Centre on Mill Street, Cape Town. It suits anyone needing an eye test, new spectacles or a change of eyewear brand, from first-time glasses wearers to people topping up an existing prescription.

Woolworths Food at Constantia Emporium is a food and grocery outlet of the Woolworths chain, run from a small to medium-sized store format rather than a full supermarket footprint. Customers describe a fresh fruit and vegetable section, freshly baked bakery products and a small in-store coffee counter, alongside the usual Woolworths grocery, ready-meal and wine range, making it a convenient stop for a quick top-up shop rather than a full weekly grocery run.

The store trades from Shop 6 in the Constantia Emporium centre on Ladies Mile Road, Constantia, and mainly serves local Constantia residents and shoppers already in the centre looking for groceries and food products alongside the centre's other shops and services.

items.description:
Baraka Gifts & Decor in Cape Quarter Lifestyle Village is a gift shop selling arts, crafts, jewellery and decor from South Africa and beyond. Its name means a blessing in Swahili, and many of its products are recycled, upcycled, handmade or fair trade, sourced from more than a hundred small, independent artisans and crafters.

The shop's range includes handmade leather notebooks and photo albums, hand-crocheted hats, shell and driftwood spoons, Panama hats, handbags and hand-woven Zulu baskets made from recycled telephone wire, alongside a few vintage pieces with a retro charm. New stock arrives regularly, so the selection keeps changing.

The shop is in De Waterkant and suits anyone looking for an affordable, distinctive gift with a story behind it, from locally made crafts to African-inspired decor.

Barrs Pharmaceutical Industries in Ndabeni is a Level 1 BEE, South African-owned pharmaceutical manufacturer licensed by SAHPRA to manufacture, package, test, distribute, import and export medicines, with more than 100 submitted and registered dossiers. The company employs over 300 full-time staff and produces liquid, semi-solid and powder formulations, including creams, ointments and tablet packs.

Its cream and ointment range includes aqueous cream, betamethasone cream, zinc and castor oil, povidone iodine, hydrocortisone cream and clotrimazole cream, among others. The company also makes a Steri range of 70 percent alcohol-based sanitisers that it describes as highly sought after in the market.

The business says it aims to be the preferred supplier in the markets it serves, producing cost-effective pharmaceutical products while contributing to the health of South Africans. It operates from Inyoni Street in Ndabeni, Cape Town.

Bassier Medical's Erica Square rooms is a general medical practice in Belhar offering doctor consultations and everyday primary healthcare. The practice accepts members of most medical aids, including several industry-specific sick funds, and also sees non-insured patients who pay privately, so care is not limited to a particular funding arrangement.

The rooms are part of a small group of Bassier Medical practices and are open for consultations on Sundays and public holidays as well as regular weekdays, giving patients access outside standard office hours. The practice trades from Erica Square in Belhar and suits patients seeking medical consultations and primary healthcare close to home, whether on medical aid or paying privately.

Bishop Lavis Primary School is a public primary school in Bishop Lavis, listed among the schools of the Metro North education district on the Western Cape provincial government's own facility records. It is run as a no-fee institution classified as Quintile 4, meaning the school receives a government allocation per learner and does not charge tuition fees to the families it serves.

The school draws its learners mainly from Bishop Lavis and the surrounding communities on the Cape Flats, within the City of Cape Town's Metro North education area. It operates from Lavis Rylaan in Lavistown, Bishop Lavis, and suits local families looking for a no-fee primary school serving their immediate community.

Block & Chisel in Diep River is a furniture and homeware showroom built around the idea of timeless design made to last generations. The range covers sectional sofas, dining sets, stools, accent chairs, lamps, outdoor chairs and dining chairs, alongside scatter cushions, throws and ceramic candle holders made under the brand's own Made by B&C line.

The showroom organises its furniture into named collections, including the Ebony, Chateau, Villa and Karoo ranges, alongside seasonal lines such as the Franschhoek range and New Villa chairs. Soft furnishings such as cushions and throws are refreshed regularly with new colours and patterns.

The showroom is on Main Road at the corner of Paddington Road in Diep River, and suits anyone furnishing a home who wants quality-crafted pieces across a range of styles.

Boxer Superstores Philippi is a branch of the Boxer discount supermarket chain, which began in 1977 in the KwaZulu-Natal community of Empangeni and has since grown into stores across every South African province as well as Eswatini. The chain positions itself as Africa's favourite discount supermarket, aimed at middle to lower-income shoppers looking for everyday value.

The Philippi branch trades from Shop 13 in The Junxion Mall, on the corner of Govan Mbeki and New Eisleben Roads in Philippi East, stocking everyday groceries and household essentials. It serves local Philippi East residents and surrounding shoppers looking for affordable, everyday grocery shopping close to home.

items.description:
Browns the Diamond Store at the V&A Waterfront is a diamond jewellery specialist marking 80 years of trading. The Victoria Wharf store carries the Browns range of signature collections, including the Protea Collection, The Queen of my Heart, The Halo, The Georgian and the Fire & Ice right-hand ring.

Other collections on offer include Precious Butterfly, Precious Blossom, Pollination, the Guardian Angel Tanzanite Collection and an 18ct gold Cleopatra piece, alongside precious gemstones such as sapphires, emeralds and rubies, and natural cognac and yellow diamonds. The store has a 4.8 rating from 56 Google reviews.

The shop is in the Quays District of Victoria Wharf Shopping Centre at the V&A Waterfront, and suits shoppers looking for fine diamond jewellery or a signature piece to mark an occasion.

items.description:
Checkers Cobble Walk is a branch of the Checkers supermarket chain, trading from the Cobble Walk Shopping Centre on the corner of Verdi Boulevard and De Villiers Street in Sonstraal Heights, Durbanville. The store offers the usual Checkers range of groceries, fresh produce, meat, bakery and household goods under one roof, drawing on the buying power of the wider Shoprite Group behind the Checkers brand.

The branch mainly serves local shoppers from Durbanville and the surrounding Sonstraal Heights area doing their everyday grocery shopping, alongside shoppers visiting Cobble Walk's other stores. It suits households looking for a full supermarket shop in a single, convenient Durbanville location.

Checkout Bonteheuwel is a local supermarket on Jakkalsvlei Avenue in Bonteheuwel, listed as covering a butchery, bakery and fruit and vegetable section alongside its general grocery store, so shoppers can do a full everyday shop in one stop. It is one of the retail and community points within Bonteheuwel's town centre, trading alongside other local shops and services on the same stretch of Jakkalsvlei Avenue.

The store serves the Bonteheuwel community and nearby residents doing their everyday grocery shopping, and keeps long trading hours into the evening on weekdays and Saturdays, with shorter Sunday hours. It suits local shoppers looking for groceries, fresh produce, meat and baked goods without having to travel outside the area.

Classic Wholesalers in Epping is a trade-only wholesaler supplying general merchandise, with sister branches in Durban, Johannesburg and Gqeberha. The business says it carries 7,500 product lines across 172 departments, positioning the Epping branch as a one-call source for a wide range of stock.

The Cape Town branch has its own contact line and reception number, separate from the other regional branches, and the wholesaler has a national administrator who can be reached for broader queries. It is part of the wider Classic Wholesalers network trading under Hsacks.

The branch is on Packer Avenue in Epping, and suits retailers and trade buyers in the Cape Town area looking for bulk general merchandise across a wide range of departments.

Clicks Airport Shopping Centre is a retail pharmacy branch inside Airport Shopping Centre in Belhar, offering a dispensary staffed by a responsible pharmacist alongside the wider Clicks range of health, beauty and personal-care products. Prescription dispensing and repeat prescriptions are handled on site, alongside everyday over-the-counter medicines, skincare, haircare and household essentials.

Trading from the corner of Belhar Drive and Stellenbosch Arterial, the branch is a convenient stop for local Belhar residents and shoppers already visiting the centre for their other errands. It suits anyone needing to fill a prescription, consult the pharmacy team on a minor ailment, or pick up everyday health, beauty and personal-care items close to home.

Clicks on Voortrekker Road in Bellville is a branch of the national retail pharmacy and health, beauty and personal-care chain found across South African high streets and shopping centres. Unlike the chain's general online catalogue, this branch is listed in its own right in current retail directories, which give it a dedicated telephone number separate from the group's national contact lines, confirming it as an individually listed, active trading address rather than just one more entry on a store-finder map.

As with other Clicks branches, the store combines a pharmacy counter with retail aisles of health, beauty and personal-care products, from skincare and cosmetics to everyday toiletries and wellness essentials, alongside the chain's ClubCard rewards programme.

Situated on Voortrekker Road in Bellville, the branch serves local residents and shoppers who want pharmacy services alongside their everyday health and beauty shopping in one visit.

Inside Brighton Square Shopping Centre on Kipling Street, Kraaifontein, Clicks Brighton Square carries its own dedicated page on the retailer's official store locator, separate from the chain's general product catalogue, listing the branch's current trading hours and confirming it as a named, individually mapped store within the Clicks network rather than a generic mall tenant.

The branch follows the format familiar across the chain, pairing a pharmacy counter with retail shelves of health, beauty and personal-care goods, from skincare and cosmetics to toiletries and everyday wellness products, supported by the group's ClubCard rewards scheme.

Trading from Brighton Square Shopping Centre in Kraaifontein, the store is a convenient stop for residents in the area needing a prescription filled or picking up beauty and personal-care essentials while they shop the rest of the centre.

items.description:
Clicks Eerste River Mall trades from Shop M14-17 in Eerste River Mall on Plein Street, and the official Clicks store locator carries a page specific to this branch, listing its current opening hours and confirming it as a distinct, individually mapped location within the national chain rather than a placeholder entry.

Like other Clicks stores, the branch pairs a pharmacy counter with retail aisles of health, beauty and personal-care products, covering skincare, cosmetics, toiletries and everyday wellness items, and participates in the group's ClubCard rewards programme that spans the chain nationally.

Based in Eerste River Mall in Eerste River, the store gives shoppers in the area a pharmacy and personal-care stop within easy reach while they are at the mall for their other shopping.

Clicks Pharmacy Glengariff, on Main Road in Three Anchor Bay, appears in current South African business-directory listings under its own name and address, which record its pharmacy trading hours separately from the chain's general store-finder information, marking it out as an identifiable, operating pharmacy rather than just a line on a national map.

The branch offers the retail pharmacy services typical of the Clicks network, including prescription dispensing and repeat prescriptions, health consultations, and retail shelves of health, beauty and personal-care products ranging from skincare to everyday toiletries.

Situated on Main Road in Three Anchor Bay, the pharmacy serves residents and visitors in the surrounding Cape Town areas who need prescription medicine or everyday health and personal-care items close to home.

Shop 6 in Strand Square Shopping Centre on Fagan Street is home to a branch of Clicks, and the retailer's official store locator carries a dedicated page for this address, confirming it as a named, individually listed store within the Strand shopping centre rather than an unlisted or generic tenant.

The Strand Square branch follows the same model as the rest of the chain, combining a pharmacy with retail aisles of health, beauty and personal-care goods, from skincare and cosmetics to toiletries and everyday wellness products, and forming part of the group's nationwide ClubCard rewards programme.

Trading from Strand Square Shopping Centre in Strand, the store is a practical stop for residents and shoppers in the area who need pharmacy services or personal-care essentials while they are at the centre.

Clip Culture CPT is a barbershop on Welgelegen Avenue in Strandfontein, with a service menu listed on its Fresha booking profile covering barbering, men's haircuts, beard trims, head shaves and hot-towel shaves. The listing sets out the shop's weekly trading pattern in detail, running from 9am on weekdays, later into the evening on Thursdays and Fridays, with a shorter Saturday morning slot and Sundays closed.

The shop focuses on traditional barbering rather than a general hair salon menu, giving customers a choice between a straightforward haircut or the fuller treatment of a hot-towel shave and beard trim.

Based on Welgelegen Avenue in Strandfontein, Clip Culture CPT suits customers looking for a dedicated barbering experience, whether for a quick trim or the full grooming routine, bookable online through its Fresha profile.

Crawford Tops is a TOPS at SPAR liquor outlet on Taronga Road in Crawford, carrying its own branch page on the SPAR group's website under the name Tops Crawford, which identifies it as part of the group's dedicated liquor retail arm rather than a generic grocery listing, alongside its own entry in a Western Cape business directory.

The store trades six days a week on a consistent daytime schedule, stocking the beer, wine and spirits range typical of a TOPS outlet, and has built up a long run of customer reviews over the years, from regulars praising its consistent stock and friendly staff to occasional complaints about queues at busy times, the kind of feedback a long-running neighbourhood liquor store tends to collect.

Situated in Crawford, the outlet serves adult customers in the surrounding area looking to pick up liquor for a gathering or top up a home bar.

items.description:
Do It Yourself Hardware on Koeberg Road in Brooklyn is a family-owned hardware and home-improvement store trading since 1974. It describes itself as a hometown hardware store supplying trusted brands and quality materials across building and materials, tools and power tools, electrical and lighting, paint and decor, plumbing and bathrooms, and outdoor and garden supplies.

The store also stocks safety and cleaning products and carries handpicked tool brands such as Leatherman, alongside power tools like impact wrenches. Staff offer expert support for builders, renovators and homeowners tackling jobs of any size.

The shop is at 39 Koeberg Road in Brooklyn, and suits anyone from a first-time DIYer to a professional builder who needs tools, materials or advice close to home.
